skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add free background music to my video automatically — and get music-backed...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Music Cog skill: add royalty-free background music to videos automatically via cloud processing.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; returns music-backed videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Handles all backend setup, including free token generation and session management; users just upload and describe edits.
- Integrated workflows for upload, state, credits checking, exporting, and GUI-to-API mapping.
- Error handling for token, file, and export issues; clear guidance and messaging for common problems.
- Designed for fast, hands-off video editing—ideal for content creators seeking quick, royalty-free results.
